item.title: New Income Tax Slabs and Rates for FY 2026-27: How Budget Affects Your Take-Home Salary
item.description: In Budget 2026, Nirmala Sitharaman focused on stability, maintaining current tax slabs while slashing TCS on foreign travel to 2%. Key highlights include a 4.3% fiscal deficit target and the transition to the New Income Tax Act on April 1. Investors saw a hike in STT on futures, while the middle class continues to enjoy zero tax up to INR 12.75 lakh.
